title: Pump Set (OPC UA, P4)
description: plant.sim:pump-set-01 from the OPC UA simulator via Telegraf. Slow DE-bearing wear raises vibration, bearing temperature and current; alarm word bits: 0 VibrationHigh, 1 VibrationTrip, 2 BearingTempHigh, 3 WindingTempHigh, 4 FlowLow, 5 MotorOvercurrent.

list.name: thing_id
list.label: Asset
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "raw", tag: "thing_id", predicate: (r) => r.feature_id == "bearing_de", start: -30d)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r.thing_id == "${thing_id}" and (r.feature_id == "motor") and (r._field == "velocity"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 60.0 / (2.0 * 3.141592653589793)}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, series: r.feature_id + "." + r._field}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])

from(bucket: "raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r.thing_id == "${thing_id}" and (r.feature_id == "motor") and (r._field == "current"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, series: r.feature_id + "." + r._field}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 3600.0}))
